market_outlook.short_term: Bearish-to-neutral. Oil above $100 and rising yields create immediate headwind. CPI report and Oracle earnings are binary catalysts. Bessent's failed intervention signals policy incoherence. Expect volatility 15-20% VIX range. Fed hike bets may force a 25bp move. Trade war with Canada adds noise.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex cycle likely continues but with rationalization (Trade Desk cuts). Apple foldable and GE Aerospace acquisitions create structural winners. US debt trajectory is the overhang. Energy transition disrupted by Iran conflict extends fossil fuel relevance. India B2B/credit and global wealth migration (UK to Europe) offer structural growth pockets.
